title: Refine and document the workspace
acceptance: Two members using the same Windows login apply distinct settings. After a full client restart on a different port, each sees their own choices.
evidence: Three Settings pages with live previews on real widgets; Apply, Cancel, Reset and a failed save; two members' distinct preferences survived a different-port client restart, with defaults for a new member. Cursor behaviour checked across pointer, keyboard and menu dismissal; launcher and component documentation updated. Pen, controller and physical phone were unavailable and are recorded as gaps. Evidence: qa/sprint-4/.
